description: This file defines the SearchEntry class, which models a search result entry containing an indexed product and highlight snippets.

classes.name: SearchEntry
classes.description: Represents a search result entry with an IndexProduct and highlights.

methods.name: setHighlights
methods.description: Sets the list of highlight snippets for this search entry.

methods.name: getHighlights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of highlight snippets.

methods.name: setIndexProduct
methods.description: Associates an IndexProduct with this search entry.

methods.name: getIndexProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the IndexProduct associated with this search entry.
